يستحق (form X)
# يَسْتَحِقُّ (yastaḥiqqu) /jas.ta.ħiq.qu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
# يُسْتَحَقُّ (yustaḥaqqu) /jus.ta.ħaq.qu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
# يَسْتَحِقَّ (yastaḥiqqa) /jas.ta.ħiq.qa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَق
